title: Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript stories vs Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code stories on points
question: Does a story about Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript get more points than a story about Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript gets more points than a story about Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code.
expect: If true, points per story for Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript stories should be at least 1.5x the value for Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript against Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code

group_a.label: Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript stories ({from} to {to})

group_b.label: Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h307 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h307 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
